title: CanonicalTrack
description: Format-independent normalized spatial evidence with explicit ordered continuity parts under the frozen v0.1 domain contract.

track_source.description: Exact immutable TrackSource revision from which this CanonicalTrack revision was normalized.

parts.description: Ordered continuity parts. No geometry or route edge exists between adjacent array elements.

normalizer.description: Parser/normalizer identity, version, and reproducibility parameters.

continuityPart.description: One ordered interval in which adjacent observations may form canonical line geometry. Array order defines part_index.

observations.description: Ordered canonical observations. A singleton is preserved evidence but cannot by itself form positive-length route geometry.

observation.description: One normalized spatial observation. Position is required; temporal and measurement capabilities are optional.

altitude_m.description: Optional altitude measurement in metres. Vertical datum semantics remain source/normalization provenance.

distance_m.description: Optional source/normalized cumulative distance in metres.

observed_speed_mps.description: Optional observed/device speed telemetry in metres per second. This is not derived geometric speed.
